_rule: Written before dryrun; uncommitted because Git metadata is read only. No live authorization.

shot-on-a.source: Static float pre-post scene plus same-frame compose delta / exposure (water-compose). Band derived from OFF repeats and encoding uncertainty; no radiance gain correction.
shot-on-a.coverage: Mode 2: offscreen shaded > 0 and hidden shaded > 0 in EVERY ON window, in both reflection and compose. Current-frame union of active froxel lights queried by world position; not every raw b25 slot (unlisted slots are stale). Truncation > 32 retains probe, counted; no preset promotion.
shot-on-a.cost_budget_source: Acceptance budget: added reflection + compose median <= 1.0 ms (about 1.5x the qualified 0.67 ms water chain); p90 <= OFF p90 + 1.0 ms. Budget only, not measured prediction; use matched diagnostic-free GPU windows.
